problems.note: Story card 2 ends with "Add one more set!", which doesn't follow from the sentence before it and is unclear by ear. Something like "Now Sam has 6 packs" would be clearer.

Story card 1 says 5 packs of 6 is 30, but the picture is only "6 × 🃏", which shows one pack, not the five packs. Story cards 3 and 4 use the same per-pack picture. A child may not see that the picture stands for one pack, so the card could say it more clearly.

The narration gives the method away ("Double 16 to find 4 × 8"), so the item tests following a hint rather than recalling the fact. Consider dropping the hint, or keeping it only for an easier version.
The narration supplies 5 × 8 = 40 and says to add one more 8, so the item is mostly a single addition. At difficulty 2 this is easier than intended. Consider removing the scaffold.
